record.paper_title: Open Problems in K-Stability of Fano Varieties
record.original_question: Let C be a smooth projective curve of genus g, let L be a fixed determinant line bundle of degree d on C, and let M_{d,r}(C) denote the Fano moduli space of rank-r polystable vector bundles on C with determinant L. Is M_{d,r}(C) K-stable for every such curve C? In addition, if X_g is the K-moduli space containing the point [M_{d,r}(C)] and X_g has a birational map to the moduli space M_g of smooth genus-g curves, give a modular interpretation of the limiting points of X_g.

evidence.quote:
Problem 9. (1) Show Md,r(C) is K-stable for any smooth projective curve C of genus g.
(2) The K-moduli space Xg containing [Md,r(C)] admits a birational map to Mg, which is
conjecturally isomorphic over Mg by (1). Give a modular interpretation of the limiting
points on X.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $C$ be a smooth projective curve of genus $g \geq 2$ over the complex numbers, let $r \geq 2$ be an integer, and let $L$ be a line bundle on $C$ of degree $d$ with $\gcd(r,d)=1$. Denote by $M_{d,r}(C)$ the moduli space of rank-$r$ stable vector bundles on $C$ with fixed determinant $L$; this is a smooth projective Fano variety.

(1) Prove that for every smooth projective curve $C$ of genus $g$, the Fano variety $M_{d,r}(C)$ is K-stable.

(2) Assuming (1), let $X_g$ denote the (projective) K-moduli space of K-polystable Fano varieties containing the points $[M_{d,r}(C)]$ as $C$ varies over smooth projective curves of genus $g$. The natural assignment $C \mapsto [M_{d,r}(C)]$ induces a birational map $\mathcal{M}_g \dashrightarrow X_g$, where $\mathcal{M}_g$ is the moduli space of smooth projective curves of genus $g$. Provide a modular interpretation of the boundary points of $X_g$ that lie outside the image of $\mathcal{M}_g$ (i.e., the limiting K-polystable degenerations of $M_{d,r}(C)$).
artifact.category_tag: K-stability of Fano moduli of vector bundles
artifact.status_search_result: The problem appears to be open in general. Recent work (e.g., on K-stability of Thaddeus' moduli of stable bundle pairs on genus two curves, 2024) addresses related but special low-genus or pair-variant cases. K-stability of $M_{d,r}(C)$ for arbitrary genus and rank, and a modular interpretation of the boundary of the corresponding K-moduli component birational to $\mathcal{M}_g$, has not been established in the literature surveyed.

status_evidence.title: K-stability of Thaddeus' moduli of stable bundle pairs on genus two curves
status_evidence.snippet: Recent work establishing K-stability for Thaddeus' moduli of stable bundle pairs over genus two curves — a related but special case.
status_evidence.claim: K-stability is currently being established only in special low-genus / pair variants, indicating the general problem remains open.

status_evidence.title: The Birational Geometry of K-Moduli Spaces
status_evidence.snippet: Components of the K-moduli of Fano varieties birational to Mg are studied; modular interpretation of boundary points is an active topic.
status_evidence.claim: Modular interpretation of boundary points in K-moduli components birational to Mg remains an active research direction.
